correction: A multi-session reversal is a sequence of daily candles, not a setup conditioned on a new five-session extreme.

formation.drive: excursion from the first session open toward the recent edge is at least 0.75 ATR20
formation.recent_edge: the formation edge occurs in one of the last two sessions
formation.stall: additional progress in the final session is no more than 0.35 ATR20
formation.recovery: the last close recovers at least 55% of the final two-session range

patterns.stall_turn: the final close improves against the preceding drive
patterns.two_close_turn: both final closes improve against the preceding drive

confirmation.trigger: 5m close beyond the high/low of the final two formation sessions plus/minus one tick
confirmation.session_multifactor: session close beyond trigger and on the reversal side of VWAP, correct daily delta, RVOL20 >= 1.1, OI contraction <= -0.5%

execution.stop: beyond the full formation extreme by 0.10 or 0.25 ATR20
execution.invalidation: cancel before entry if the protective stop level is touched

costs.funding: actual signed SWAPRATE with adverse fallback when missing
